visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three characters are seen in an indoor room with light wood furniture and warm studio lighting. An older woman in a bright red polo shirt stands centrally behind a large plate of purple taro paste. To her left, a young man in a black tank top listens intently, while to her right, another person in a black bucket hat and glasses reacts with curiosity. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor wetland environment under natural daylight. A person wearing a black hat and gloves is bent over, harvesting taro plants from knee-deep water. Green taro leaves are prominent, and the background shows a lush mountain landscape under a bright, slightly overcast sky. (3) Back in the indoor setting, the lighting is bright and artificial. The older woman holds a small, greyish piece of steamed taro between her fingers, gesturing as she speaks. The two younger characters lean in, focusing on the taro piece. A poster with taro imagery is visible on the wall behind them. (4) The younger man takes a bite of the purple paste, smiling broadly with squinted eyes. The person in the bucket hat also tastes the food, using their hands to express excitement. Yellow and white variety subtitles appear at the bottom of the frame, emphasizing the high-energy interactions and facial expressions. (5) The older woman presents a green leaf to the young man. He takes it, smells it, and bursts into laughter, looking towards the camera with an amused expression. The camera stays at eye-level, capturing the group's lighthearted and humorous exchange as they conclude their tasting session.
